It's finished and published! The first MYOS of March! The idea was from that one very generous person that purchased the most expensive reward on the Charity Event last December, so I had to do that person's idea first in honor to such generous act. The idea was that there were these "Latex Toy Soldiers" that would go around chasing people and "hijacking" their bodies and control them and at the same time make them look like Latex Toy Soldiers. The idea of having a queen in it and adding the characters from TLITD were added later on. What do you think? Do you like the idea of this story? At first I have to confess I wasn't too sure about it, but in the end I ended up liking it!

On a side note, this story is shorter than the average because tomorrow the voting for the second MYOS will begin, there's still another story that I need to make!

And on a last and important note, this story is free! That's right, if you head over to my Fanbox you can have the download link to download the story and enjoy it ANYWHERE!!
